stages.headline: An expression built from numbers and variables using +, −, · and powers is called an integer (polynomial) expression.
stages.headlineEnglish: An expression built from numbers and variables using +, −, · and powers is called an integer (polynomial) expression.

stages.headline: When evaluating, it is often easier to simplify first and then substitute.

stages.headline: An integer expression makes sense for every value of the variables because there is no division by a variable.
